--FOR TRU RECORDS FILTER
WITH CustomerAccountBalance_LNS AS (
SELECT 

	MAX(Timestamp) AS Timestamp
	,CustomerAccountId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BalancetypeId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
	WHERE BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BalancetypeId
)
, FINANCIALPRODUCTAPPLICATION 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication A
	JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.FinancialProductApplication GROUP BY FinancialProductId, FinancialInstitutionId, FcbsApplicationId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.FinancialProductId = B.FinancialProductId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode AND A.FcbsApplicationId = B.FcbsApplicationId  AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp
)





, TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT 
AS(
	SELECT 
	 BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
	,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
	,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
	,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
	,CASE 
		 WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
		 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
	,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
	,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
	,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
	,-1 AS BranchSK
	,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm

	FROM (SELECT CA.CustomerAccountId,CA.CustomerAccountName,CA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CA.IsoCurrencyCode,CA.SourceSystemCode,CA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,CA.BRANCHID
	FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY CustomerAccountName) AS RN, CustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountName, CustomerAccountOpenedDate, IsoCurrencyCode, SourceSystemCode, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID, BRANCHID 
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) CA
	WHERE CA.RN = 1) BCA 
	LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' ) --NO DATA
	LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL OR BCAS.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
	LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
	LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
	LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
	--LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
	WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
	GROUP BY 
	BCA.CustomerAccountId
	,BCA.CustomerAccountName
	,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
	,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
	,BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID
	,BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
	,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
	,DDB.BankSK
	,BCA.SourceSystemCode
	,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId

) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT AccountID) AS Total FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
